fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Rotor Dynamics (Cp-lambda + J*dw/dt ODE)
source: Bahaj & Myers (2003) Renewable Energy 28(14); Bahaj et al. (2007) Renewable Energy 32(3); Fraenkel (2002, 2007) SeaGen / Marine Current Turbines, Proc. IMechE Part A

unit.name: Generic 1 MW Horizontal-Axis Tidal Stream Turbine (SeaGen-class)

rated_power.note: Rated electrical output; SeaGen rotor ~ 600-1200 kW per rotor (Fraenkel 2007)

rotor_diameter.note: Rotor diameter; SeaGen used 16 m twin rotors, IEC-class 15-20 m

Cp_max.note: Peak power coefficient; Bahaj & Myers (2003) measured 0.40-0.45 in cavitation tunnel; Betz limit = 0.593

lambda_opt.note: Optimal tip-speed ratio (R*omega/v); Bahaj et al. (2007) BEM peak ~ TSR 4-6

lambda_zero.note: TSR at which Cp falls back to zero (windmill runaway end of usable curve)

rho_water.note: Seawater density at S=35 PSU, T=10C; Bahaj & Myers (2003), IEC TS 62600-200. ~837x air (1.225)

cut_in_speed.note: Minimum current speed for net generation; Fraenkel (2007)

rated_speed.note: Current speed at which rated power is reached; SeaGen rated ~ 2.4 m/s

cut_out_speed.note: Maximum operating current speed (storm / structural protection)

J_rotor.note: Lumped rotor + drivetrain inertia (rotor inertia ~ 0.5*m_blades*R^2 scale for 20 m rotor)

omega_rated.note: Rated rotor angular speed = lambda_opt*v_rated/R = 4.5*2.5/10 = 1.125 rad/s (~10.7 rpm)

K_gen_gain.note: Below-rated optimal torque-control gain T_gen = K*omega^2, K=0.5*rho*A*R^3*Cp_max/lambda_opt^3 (Burton et al. wind-analogue optimal-mode-gain)
